name: io.github.bikemeardsley/thicken
description: Photos in: a 3D model at the object's real size and its metadata as JSON, for any kind of object.

environmentVariables.name: THICKEN_VISION_URL
environmentVariables.description: An OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (optional): photos needn't be cropped

environmentVariables.name: THICKEN_VISION_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint's model names, comma-separated, primary first

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Google Books quota, for book sizes
